title: Access Control
text: All staff must use multi-factor authentication (MFA) when signing in to company systems. Passwords must contain at least 14 characters. Account lockout begins after 5 failed sign-in attempts and lasts 15 minutes.

title: Data Retention
text: Customer support tickets are retained for 24 months after closure. Security audit logs are retained for 12 months. Deleted records remain in the backup system for up to 30 days before backup expiry.

title: Incident Response
text: Employees must report suspected security incidents to the Security Operations team within 30 minutes of discovery. The on-call lead acknowledges a critical incident within 10 minutes. A post-incident review must be completed within 5 business days.

title: Backups and Recovery
text: Production databases are backed up every 6 hours. The recovery point objective (RPO) is 6 hours and the recovery time objective (RTO) is 4 hours. Backup restoration tests are performed monthly.

title: API Security
text: API requests must use TLS 1.2 or newer. Access tokens expire after 60 minutes. The API allows 100 requests per minute per user by default. Clients receive HTTP 429 when the rate limit is exceeded.

title: Privacy Requests
text: A verified customer data-access request must receive a response within 30 calendar days. Identity must be verified before exporting personal data. Requests to correct profile details are normally completed within 7 business days.

title: Deployment Process
text: Changes require approval from one code owner and one reviewer before production deployment. The CI pipeline must pass unit tests and dependency scanning. Production deployments are scheduled Tuesday through Thursday, 10:00–16:00 local time, except emergency fixes.

title: Monitoring
text: The service availability target is 99.9% per calendar month. The latency alert threshold is a p95 response time above 800 milliseconds for 5 consecutive minutes. On-call engineers must acknowledge a page within 10 minutes.

title: Employee Training
text: New employees must complete security awareness training within 10 business days of joining. Refresher training is required annually. Phishing simulations are conducted quarterly.

title: Expense Reimbursement
text: Employees must submit expense claims within 45 calendar days of purchase. Receipts are required for expenses above $25. Approved reimbursements are paid in the next monthly payment cycle.

title: Service Support
text: Standard support operates Monday through Friday, 09:00–17:00 UTC. Priority-one incidents have a 15-minute initial response target. Standard requests have a 2-business-day initial response target.

title: Encryption
text: Data in transit must be encrypted with TLS 1.2 or newer. Sensitive data at rest must use AES-256 encryption. Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days and stored in the managed key service.
